source_images_viewed.observation: Title and Baptiste Cercle author agree with the bound arXiv:2208.12085v3, 17 Dec 2024 stamp.

Proposition 2.1 defines A_N inside (Q+C_-)^N with both sum constraints >-gamma and the per-insertion minimum deficit <-gamma; Theorem 2.2 and explicit excluded poles are visible. The report's P3 admissibility and P1 pole limits correspond to this definition.
Equations (2.33),(2.34) visibly use the maximum/vee thresholds. The immediately following sufficient L1 condition requires each insertion deficit >gamma, retaining the report's counterevidence.
The actual first-moment invocation of (2.34) explicitly uses 1<(Q-alpha1,e1)/gamma. This supports the report's limitation on the impact of the misstated general moment range.

Section 2.4.7 explicitly infers a uniformly bounded complex neighborhood from the real bound, fixed-c holomorphy and c-continuity, then applies Fubini-Tonelli and Morera. Matches P1's target inference rather than a claimed counterexample to the actual Toda integrand.
The unscaled H0,H1,H2 in (3.2),(3.4),(3.5), theorem weight restrictions and nonreciprocal coefficient product in (3.6),(3.7) are visible, matching P2's stated normalization.

Proposition 3.2 quantifies over every pair in {0,B1,B2,A1,A2,A3}, requiring noninteger real differences, and prints the same nonreciprocal coefficients in (3.12). These are the hypotheses retained in the report.

Equation (3.13) visibly uses positive A_i infinity prefactor, and the connection calculation defines lambda-tilde_i=lambda_i A_gamma^(i). The gamma reflection identity reads pi/sin(pi z), matching the prior rejected extraction concern.
The top concludes lambda0=lambda-tilde1=lambda-tilde2; this matches the report's reciprocal-normalization evidence. Theorem 4.1 and its reliance on Theorem 3.1 assumptions are also visible.
The gamma>1 case states gamma<(alpha0,e1)<2/gamma and q-epsilon<(alpha0,e2)<q; the displayed Taylor subtraction is visible, matching the P3 regime and P5 propagation location.

The unnumbered double integral immediately before (4.12) visibly has |x-y|^(-2 gamma^2) and is asserted absolutely integrable, then used for an O(z^2) remainder. Original damped terms are separately visible, consistent with the report's impact limit.

Lemma 4.3 explicitly assumes a<2,b>-2 and the exclusions on a-b; its r_ab definition visibly has a plus first-order term inside the subtraction. The preceding coefficient identities and continuation use match the locations cited in P2/P5.
Equations (5.6),(5.7), dual-shift parameter range and dense-period/continuity passage are visible, matching the stated downstream dependencies without asserting the final formula has been disproved.

items: All extracted text read; normalization, Seiberg domain, reflection poles/cocycle/counterterms and real estimates followed; complex-neighborhood inference independently falsified.
BPZ continuation and real solution space read; inverse normalization independently checked using gamma connection matrix and exact sine identity; no full Ward theorem reproving.
All three OPE regimes, reflection cancellations and continuation dependencies read; diagonal integrability disproved under explicit A4 weights; subtraction sign error proved.
Upsilon shifts, dual-shift parameter restriction, dense periods and DOZZ residue normalization read; long Upsilon algebra not independently reproduced in full.
All bibliography entries read; imported reflection, fusion, Ward and DOZZ results identified but not fully audited.
limitations: Imported probabilistic results not independently reproved; not every uniform OPE error estimate independently established.
Connection numerical check is high precision, not rigorous interval arithmetic; analytic sine identity and epsilon family provide proof-level support.

independent_acceptance_scope.method: Independent analytic reconstruction of the complex-domination counterfamily, gamma/sine connection coefficients, diagonal singularity and admissible Toda weights, GMC first-moment counterexample, and Taylor counterterm. Current executor-specified exact symbolic calculations and 80-decimal-digit numerical corroboration are saved in verification/0304/acceptance_1321973d/exact_checks.json. The fixed-other-weight proximity and all 1296 Weyl tuples in each of two parameter families are checked in verification/0304/acceptance_1321973d/fixed_weight_proximity.json. Floating-point residuals are corroboration, not interval certification. No author code, installation or separate scientific agent.
independent_acceptance_scope.scope: Focused independent verification of every reported P1-P5 against the exact acquired arXiv:2208.12085v3, including conventions, domains, quantifiers, nonresonance, proof dependencies and boundary cases. This is not a fresh complete 73-page review, a complete recursive external-reference audit, or certification of journal-version equivalence. None of these findings disproves the final Fateev-Litvinov formula.
independent_acceptance_scope.clarifications: For P3, a second family holds alpha1 and alphaInf fixed with eta=1/1000 while delta in alpha0 approaches zero. This addresses the sufficiently-close quantifier without moving the other weights. It establishes the local OPE assumptions used by the bare-integral step, not membership of every reflected three-point tuple in the final theorem's domain. The existing mathematical report remains unchanged; only damaged range punctuation in metadata is restored.
